(3) Clamp fidelity: a clamped value keeps its caret label with its true value at 390 as at 1800 (n67 .34, '+49.0 kg'), and a stacked bar past the clamp keeps every segment readable instead of only its lowest (n64 .13: 2,026 quota refusals vanished). (4) A dot at the first or last x is drawn whole: the plot insets a continuous x so an end mark is not cut by the plot edge (n63 .9 today's dot, n67 .34 the intensity dots). If this needs an x `pad` field, split it behind a Spec row.
